Specification: This module is a TLC model-checking wrapper for a write-through cache specification. It extends an already-instantiated cache module, defines concrete replacements for the memory-interface constants Send, Reply, and InitMemInt, and then manually inlines a refinement target corresponding to an InternalMemory specification because the referenced TLC version cannot handle module instantiation. The file checks that the resulting internal-memory-style specification satisfies a type invariant, states a theorem that the hand-instantiated specification implies that invariant always, and defines a leads-to liveness property saying that every busy controller eventually becomes ready.
